sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] gen:TRF104ShipShape / nltl:propellerBladeLoss: The requirement describes propeller-blade loss as the design scenario under which damage must be assessed; it does not require every ship to assert a mandatory boolean value of true for propellerBladeLoss. sh:minCount 1 with sh:hasValue true therefore changes applicability semantics by making blade loss universally applicable. Required change: Remove the mandatory true-value constraint, or remove this property constraint entirely if blade loss is represented only as the comparison scenario rather than as ship data.

[INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] gen:TRF104ShipShape / sh:path nltl:pyramidStrengthPrinciple: The sh:pattern constraint imposes an unrequired lexical restriction on the xsd:string value. The requirement and direct property/presence encoding require identification of the pyramid strength principle but do not require the exact case-insensitive phrase to occur in the value, so compliant descriptions can be rejected. Required change: Remove sh:pattern "pyramid strength principle" and sh:flags "i"; retain the canonical property, xsd:string datatype, and presence constraint.

[CARDINALITY] gen:TRF104ShipShape property sh:path nltl:hasPropellerShaftLineComponent: The component relationship has no minimum cardinality, so a ship with no linked propeller shaft line components can conform without evaluating the required blade-loss damage condition. Required change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the hasPropellerShaftLineComponent property shape.
